purpose: Complete OCR/receipt matching and the owner-facing UI without opening tax, AI, speech, MTD filing or browser-parity work.

allowed: PaddleOCR-family versus credible local baseline benchmark
stages.hard_stop: No OCR production dependency or product wiring before Stage A PASS.
Only the Stage A selected runtime/model/version may be introduced; dependency-change controls apply.
OCR facts may suggest matches only; user confirmation remains mandatory before accounting action.
SBC-7 product implementation remains blocked until SBC-6 PASS.
UI must call Shark-owned application/facade contracts and must not own accounting rules.

stages.required_flow: receipt/document -> OCR facts -> deterministic suggestion -> user confirmation -> existing bookkeeping/document path -> visible UI state

stages.hard_stop: No SBC-8 product implementation inside this batch.

non_negotiables: No Shark central ledger or document custody.
Native production books remain SQLCipher encrypted.
No raw SQLite/rusqlite/Beankeeper persistence surface to UI or OCR.
All accounting persistence remains behind the approved Shark facade and validation-before-persistence invariant.
OCR extracts factual evidence only; no tax/accounting category, deductibility, VAT, CIS, payroll or company judgement.
No silent matching, posting, clearing or reconciliation from OCR.
Dependency changes require exact pins, licence/NOTICE review, SBOM/adjudication and relevant Windows/Apple proof.
batch_exit: SBC-8 implementation contract prepared but not executed
